subject: Free Hanukkah pages, new puppy pages, and names for holiday cards
preview: A menorah to color before Hanukkah starts Dec 4, new dog and cat pages, and name tracing for signing cards.
intro: December starts this week, and Hanukkah begins at sundown on Friday, December 4. Here are a few free pages to print for the busy weeks ahead.

free.title: Hanukkah coloring pages
free.blurb: A menorah, a dreidel, latkes, jelly doughnuts and gelt. Color one more flame on the menorah each night.

free.title: Name tracing
free.blurb: Type your child's name and print a page or two of practice before they sign their own holiday cards.

free.title: Dog coloring pages
free.blurb: New this month: a puppy bath, a dachshund, puppies in a basket and a walk around the block.

free.title: Cat coloring pages
free.blurb: Also new: a kitten with yarn, a cat in a box and a sleepy cat, simple enough for preschoolers.

picture.alt: Line drawing of a Hanukkah menorah with nine candles and the center candle raised higher, ready to color
picture.caption: The menorah page doubles as an eight-night countdown.

featureNote: Type any name, so one membership covers a book for every child in the house, and for visiting cousins over the holidays too.

tip.title: Let them sign the cards
tip.body: Print a name tracing page and have your child trace their name two or three times. Then hand them one holiday card a day to sign on their own. A wobbly name is perfect, and five minutes a day is plenty.
